name: 30 Pack - 30x1g Pre-roll - White Runtz
description:
Thirty joints, one box. The 30 Pack White Runtz gives you thirty full-gram pre-rolls — 30 grams total — rolled with quality flower and ready to smoke. No grinding, no rolling, no running out. Just grab one and go.

White Runtz is a celebrated phenotype of the Runtz line — a Zkittlez and Gelato cross — named for its frosty, resin-heavy coating. Expect a candy-forward profile: sweet tropical fruit and sugary berry notes up front, rounded out by a creamy, smooth finish. The effect is balanced and easygoing — a happy, uplifting lift paired with gentle full-body relaxation that stays mellow start to finish.

Why you'll love it:

30 × 1G pre-rolls — 30 grams total, serious value in one box
Ready to smoke — no grinding, no rolling, no setup
Signature White Runtz flavor — sweet candy fruit and sugary berry with a creamy finish
Balanced hybrid effects — uplifting, relaxed, and versatile any time of day

Big value, dependable quality, and everyday convenience in every box. The 30 Pack White Runtz is ready whenever you are.

For adult use only. Must be 21+. Keep out of reach of children and pets.
